begin sotha_rewound

float timer
short selectspell


if(GetSpeed <= 1)
	setHealth 0
endif


if(timer > 5)
	set selectspell to random, 3
	set timer to 0
	if(selectspell == 0)
		AddSpell "sotha_fabspell1"
		RemoveSpell "sotha_fabspell2"
		RemoveSpell "sotha_fabspell3"
	endif
	if(selectspell == 1)
		RemoveSpell "sotha_fabspell1"
		AddSpell "sotha_fabspell2"
		RemoveSpell "sotha_fabspell3"
	endif
	if(selectspell == 2)
		RemoveSpell "sotha_fabspell1"
		RemoveSpell "sotha_fabspell2"
		AddSpell "sotha_fabspell3"
	endif
endif

set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)

end

begin sotha_scrollwriter


short state

if ( GetDistance, Player > 200 )		
	rotateworld, y, 360	;spins around in air above Azura's hand, I'd like to give it a light too.
endif


if(OnActivate == 1)
	set state to 10
endif

if(state == 10)
	if( Player-> GetItemCount "sc_paper plain" >= 10)
		MessageBox "You turn some of your plain paper into an enchantable scroll."
		PlaySound "book page2"
		Player-> RemoveItem "sc_paper plain" 10
		 Player-> AddItem "sotha_enchantablescroll" 1
	else
		MessageBox "You would need about ten sheets of paper to write an enchantable scroll"
	endif
	set state to 0
endif


end

Begin Sotha_sehtlegsscript

short OnPCEquip
short legsOnline
short jumping
short swimming
short running
short sneaking

short hasSpell1
short hasSpell2
short hasSpell3



if(MenuMode == 1)
	return
endif

if ( OnPCEquip == 1 )
	set legsOnline to 1
else
	set legsOnline to 0
endif

set hasSpell1 to ( player->GetSpell "sotha_sehtjumping" )
set hasSpell2 to ( player->GetSpell "sotha_sehtrunning" )
set hasSpell3 to ( player->GetSpell "sotha_swimming" )

if(legsOnline == 1)
	set swimming to Player-> GetPos, Z

	if ( GetPCJumping == 1 )
		player-> addspell "sotha_sehtjumping"
	else
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtjumping"
	endif

	if(GetPCRunning == 1)
		player-> addspell "sotha_sehtrunning"
	else
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtrunning"
	endif

	if(GetPCSneaking == 1)
		player-> addspell "sotha_sehtsneaking"
	else
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtsneaking"
	endif

	if(GetPCSneaking == 1)
		player-> addspell "sotha_sehtsneaking"
	else
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtsneaking"
	endif

	if( swimming < GetWaterLevel)
		player-> addspell "sotha_swimming"
	else
		player-> removespell "sotha_swimming"
	endif

elseif(legsOnline == 0)
	if(hasSpell1 == 1)
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtrunning"
	endif
	if(hasSpell2 == 1)
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtsneaking"
	endif
	if(hasSpell3 == 1)
		player-> removespell "sotha_swimming"
	endif
endif

end

begin Sotha_travelhusbadscript

short looted
short init
short walkstate
 
if(init == 0)
setAlarm 50
set init to 1
endif
 
if(Sotha_Lived == 2)
    setHealth, 0
endif
    
if(OnActivate == 1)
    if(GetHealth <= 0)
        if(looted == 0)
            Player-> AddItem "sotha_pneuma" 1
            Player-> Additem "Gold_001" 5
		  PlaySound "Item Armor Light Up"
            MessageBox "You loot the fabricant for its pneuma and possesions"
            set looted to 1
        endif
	else
		   Activate
    endif
endif

if(GameHour >= 20)
		set walkstate to 1
endif

if(GameHour < 20)
	set walkstate to 0
	enable
endif

if(GameHour > 21)	
	set walkstate to 0
endif


if(GameHour < 24)
	if(GameHour > 21)
		disable
		set walkstate to 0
	endif
endif

if ( walkstate == 1 )
	AiTravel 5312, 512, 15120, 0
endif

end

begin SothaCataLever1

;each lever gets a script that controls itself, and moves the door based on the door's
;local state (each door has LocalState script on it).
;sounds should be tagged in animations

short state		;the state of the lever, 0 down, 1 up
short move		;tells the lever and door to move


if ( OnActivate == 1 )
	set move to 1
endif

if  ( move == 1 )
	
	;animate the lever
	if ( state == 0 )
			playgroup "idle2"
			set state to 1
	else
			playgroup "idle3"
			set state to 0
	endif

	;animate the door
	if (  "act_sotha_catadoor1".state == 0 )

			;push anims on to open
			"act_sotha_catadoor1"->playgroup "idle2"
			set  "act_sotha_catadoor1".state to 1

	else	
			;push anims on to close
			"act_sotha_catadoor1"->playgroup "idle3"
			set  "act_sotha_catadoor1".state to 0

	endif

	set move to 0

endif

end
